name: v0.3.35 submit after a long search payload
research_question: After a long search payload, does one untried button on that same signature confirm the boundary search bug without losing Guard bugs?
diagnosis: On brook budget 120 the candidate typed the 25-character search payload and the next step left through nav_roster. The query button was clicked only on other signatures, so the boundary search bug stayed unconfirmed. Guard also missed that bug. The v0.3.34 module is not edited. The rule takes a button, not a link.
not: an edit of the frozen v0.3.34 candidate
permission to take a hub link
permission to change the product default
permission to retune after the fresh matrix

candidate.rule: When a search field receives the long payload, arm a one-shot for the destination signature. On the next decision with that signature, take the first untried button. Do not take a link. Any other signature drops the one-shot.

topology_rule: New positives keep the chart-to-prefs page. The home page keeps the search field and its query button. Submit, probe, and export stay on the prefs page.

outcomes.C: Guard loss on a fresh target, historical Guard loss, safety violation, negative handoff, candidate edit, or product-default change
outcomes.D: Safety holds but fewer than 3 positives are evaluable
outcomes.B: Guard bugs are kept and at least 3 positives are evaluable, but fewer than 3 keep every Guard bug, confirm the boundary search bug, and record a search-submit selection
outcomes.A: At least 3 positives keep every Guard bug, confirm the boundary search bug, and record a search-submit selection. Negatives have no nested handoff. The historical suite loses no Guard bug. The product default stays unchanged.
